revenue.source: LMT Q4/FY2025, FY2024 and FY2023 earnings releases / 10-K consolidated statements of earnings (net sales)

operating_income.source: LMT FY2023-FY2025 earnings releases, consolidated operating profit (FY2025 incl. $950M and $570M program losses in Q2; FY2024 incl. program losses)

d_and_a.source: LMT cash flow statements, depreciation and amortization, FY2024 and FY2025 earnings releases

capex.source: LMT cash flow statements, capital expenditures (shown positive), FY2025 earnings release / 10-K

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2026 = midpoint of company guidance $77.5-80.0B vs FY2025 $75.048B (+4.9%); then fading toward long-run defense budget growth (backlog/munitions ramp).

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 reported 10.3% depressed by ~$1.5B program charges; FY2023 12.6%, FY2024 9.9%. FY2026 guidance segment profit $8.425-8.675B (~10.9% of mid sales) plus FAS/CAS ~ $1.365B partly non-service; 11.0% used as normalized margin.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: approximate LMT effective tax rate in recent years (~16-17%) with R&D credits and FDII benefits; rounded, not a filed figure.

capex_pct_revenue.source: FY2026 guidance capex ~$1,900M / mid guided sales $78.75B = 2.4%; FY2025 was 2.2%.

wacc.source: Assumption: CAPM with ~4.3% risk-free, beta ~0.5-0.6, ERP ~5% gives cost of equity ~7-8%, after-tax cost of debt ~4%, moderate leverage; 7.5% chosen. Not from a data provider.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: roughly long-run nominal GDP/inflation-level growth, conservative for a mature defense prime.

net_debt.source: LMT 10-K / FY2025 release balance sheet at Dec 31, 2025: current maturities of LTD 1,168 + long-term debt, net 20,532 = 21,700, less cash 4,121; no short-term investments reported. Leases excluded.

diluted_shares.source: LMT FY2025 weighted average diluted shares, 233.5 million (EPS note / Q4 FY2025 release)
